categories.name_zh: 官方 CLI 与开发套件
categories.description_en: First-party command-line harnesses and SDKs maintained under `google-antigravity` for terminal workflows and programmatic agent orchestration.
categories.description_zh: 由 `google-antigravity` 官方维护的终端命令行工具与 SDK，支持命令行编排与程序化 Agent 开发。

categories.name_zh: IDE 扩展与专属控制台
categories.description_en: Extensions and desktop applications designed exclusively to monitor Antigravity model quotas, manage accounts, and provide HUD telemetry.
categories.description_zh: 专为 Antigravity 模型配额监控、状态栏倒计时与账号管理打造的桌面应用与扩展。

categories.name_zh: 平台补丁与底层运行时修复
categories.description_en: System-level hotfixes, localization injectors, network bridges, and patches solving core Antigravity bugs and OS runtime limitations.
categories.description_zh: 正面攻克 Antigravity 官方客户端特定缺陷、汉化注入、无 TUN 代理、符号链接失效与进程死锁的底层工具。

categories.name_en: Dedicated Gateways, ACP Adapters & Migration Tooling
categories.name_zh: 专用网关、ACP 适配器与迁移工具
categories.description_en: Engineering utilities built around the official Antigravity Agent Client Protocol (`agy acp`), native plugin specifications (`plugin.json`), and companion Google AI (Flow) media API gateways.
categories.description_zh: 围绕 Antigravity 官方核心协议（`agy acp`）、原生插件规范（`plugin.json`）以及 Google AI（Flow）生态配套媒体网关打造的高性能工程工具。

tools.name: antigravity-cli
tools.description_en: Official Antigravity CLI (`agy`) bringing the reasoning, execution, and orchestration capabilities of the Antigravity agent harness directly into the terminal.
tools.description_zh: Google Antigravity 官方命令行工具（`agy`），将 Antigravity 的推理、执行与编排能力原生引入终端环境。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: First-party official CLI harness for Google Antigravity (`agy` and `agy acp`).
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: Google Antigravity 官方终端命令行本体（`agy` 与 `agy acp`）。
tools.install_hint: Follow official installer instructions in google-antigravity/antigravity-cli

tools.name: antigravity-sdk-python
tools.description_en: Official Apache-2.0 Python SDK for building programmatic AI agents and workflows powered directly by Google Antigravity.
tools.description_zh: Google Antigravity 官方 Apache-2.0 Python SDK，用于以代码方式构建和编排 Antigravity AI 智能体。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Official Python client library purpose-built for Google Antigravity's agent runtime.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 专为 Google Antigravity 智能体运行时打造的官方 Python 开发套件。
tools.install_hint: pip install antigravity-sdk (check repo README for exact package name)

tools.name: agy-meme
tools.description_en: Bidirectional Neko reaction stickers, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+M inline composer picker, and Desktop-isolated zero-dependency MCP plugin (48 universal RGBA die-cut WebP stickers) for Google Antigravity Desktop.
tools.description_zh: 专为 Google Antigravity 桌面端打造的双向猫娘表情贴纸渲染、Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+M 输入框选图面板与终端静默隔离原生 MCP 插件（内置 48 张全球通用无字透明模切贴纸）。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Built exclusively on Antigravity's native plugin.json specification and Antigravity Desktop 2.0+ Electron app.asar IPC/preload overlay with automatic agy CLI process-tree isolation.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 深度基于 Antigravity 原生 plugin.json 插件规范与桌面端 app.asar 双向气泡渲染构建，具备 agy CLI 进程树自动识别静默隔离机制。

tools.name: Antigravity-Manager
tools.description_en: Native desktop account manager and one-click switcher for Antigravity built with Tauri v2 (Rust) and React.
tools.description_zh: 基于 Rust (Tauri v2) + React 构建的桌面级 Antigravity 账号管理与一键切换工具。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Targets Antigravity's local profile, authentication state, and account switching workflow natively.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 直接面向 Antigravity 本地账号配置与一键切换流程构建。
tools.install_hint: Download platform installer from GitHub Releases

tools.name: antigravity-panel
tools.description_en: Quota monitor and cache manager for Google Antigravity IDE tracking Gemini, Claude, and GPT limits with usage trend analytics.
tools.description_zh: 专为 Google Antigravity IDE 打造的配额监控与缓存管理面板，支持多模型额度、周限额与趋势统计。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Reads Google Antigravity IDE local quota telemetry and cache directories directly.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 直接对接 Google Antigravity IDE 本地配额数据与缓存目录。
tools.install_hint: Install VSIX from GitHub Releases or VS Code Marketplace

tools.name: AntigravityManager
tools.description_en: Desktop application for managing Google accounts across Antigravity Classic, Antigravity IDE, and `agy` CLI with real-time quota views.
tools.description_zh: 面向 Antigravity Classic、Antigravity IDE 与 `agy` CLI 的多客户端账号管理桌面端，支持实时配额查看与无缝切换。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Built specifically around Antigravity Classic, Antigravity IDE, and `agy` CLI local account and quota storage.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 专门适配 Antigravity Classic、IDE 与 `agy` CLI 的本地账号与配额体系。

tools.name: vscode-antigravity-cockpit
tools.description_en: VS Code extension for real-time Antigravity model quota tracking, status bar countdowns, multi-model pinning, and capability HUDs.
tools.description_zh: Antigravity 标杆级 VS Code 扩展，支持多模型配额实时监控、状态栏倒计时提示、多模型置顶及模型能力 HUD。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Purpose-built HUD and quota dashboard tailored exclusively to Antigravity's model catalog and reset windows.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 专为 Antigravity 模型配额周期与能力面板设计的实时控制台扩展。
tools.install_hint: Install from VS Code Marketplace / Open VSX or GitHub Releases

tools.name: agy-desktop-exo
tools.description_en: UX enhancements (compact wide-layout toggle, inline Office/EPUB sidebar preview) and Simplified Chinese localization for Google Antigravity Desktop.
tools.description_zh: 面向 Google Antigravity 桌面端的体验增强（紧凑加宽布局开关、Office/EPUB 侧边栏速览）与简体中文汉化引擎。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Built exclusively for Antigravity Desktop 2.0+ Electron app.asar patching with strict content isolation and inside-out macOS codesigning.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 专为 Antigravity 2.0+ 桌面端 app.asar 定向注入与 macOS 由内而外重签名打造。

tools.name: Antigravity-Chinese-Localization
tools.description_en: MIT-licensed one-click Chinese localization toolkit and UI translation patch tailored for Google Antigravity IDE.
tools.description_zh: MIT 开源协议的 Antigravity IDE 一键中文汉化工具包，精准覆盖客户端界面与菜单词条。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Targets Antigravity IDE's bundled UI string tables and resource packages exclusively.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 专为 Antigravity IDE 客户端界面资源与词条结构定制的汉化补丁。
tools.install_hint: Run localization script per repository README

tools.name: antigravity-junction-skill-fix
tools.description_en: Zero-copy NTFS hardlink directory bridge that resolves Go language server discovery failures for Windows directory junctions (`mklink /J`) and symlinks (`mklink /D`).
tools.description_zh: 零磁盘占用 NTFS 硬链接目录桥接工具，彻底解决 Antigravity Go Language Server 无法加载 Windows 目录联接 (`mklink /J`) 与符号链接 (`mklink /D`) 的硬伤问题。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Solves the Antigravity Go language server (`language_server_windows_x64.exe`) reparse-point skip bug via a native `SessionStart` plugin hook.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 通过 Antigravity 原生 `SessionStart` 钩子解决其 Go 语言服务器忽略 NTFS 重解析点的缺陷。

tools.name: antigravity-proxy
tools.description_en: Transparent Windows DLL-injection proxy utility that routes Antigravity process traffic through SOCKS5/HTTP proxies without requiring TUN mode.
tools.description_zh: 专为 Antigravity 打造的 Windows 免 TUN 强制代理工具，基于 DLL 注入实现进程级 SOCKS5/HTTP 流量转发。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Targets Antigravity's Windows child processes (including language server binaries) that ignore system proxy settings.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 针对 Antigravity Windows 底层子进程忽略系统代理的痛点进行定向进程劫持。
tools.install_hint: Download release package and launch Antigravity through antigravity-proxy

tools.name: vscode-antigravity-backend-fix
tools.description_en: Hotfix for the official VS Code Antigravity extension resolving the repeated ~202 MB `agy.exe` background download loop caused by Windows Defender timeouts.
tools.description_zh: 官方 VS Code 插件热修补工具，彻底解决 Windows Defender 超时引发的每次启动重复下载 ~202MB `agy.exe` 的网络拥堵与进程锁死问题。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Patches the official VS Code Antigravity extension's `agy.exe` binary extraction and startup verification timeout.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 专治官方 VS Code Antigravity 扩展因 Defender 扫描超时导致的 `agy.exe` 无限重复下载故障。
tools.install_hint: Follow automated patch script in repository README

tools.name: ACP-Ant
tools.description_en: OpenAI and Anthropic compatible API server bridging Google's official Antigravity CLI over ACP with per-account proxy and tool-calling support.
tools.description_zh: 基于 Google 官方 Antigravity CLI ACP 协议构建的 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API 服务，支持多账号独立代理与工具调用。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Drives Google's official `agy` CLI strictly through its Agent Client Protocol interface.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 严格通过官方 `agy` CLI 的 ACP 协议暴露标准兼容 API 网关。
tools.install_hint: Clone repo and install Python dependencies per README

tools.name: agy-remote-wecom
tools.description_en: Control local Antigravity (agy) terminal and background agy acp sessions from WeCom on macOS over an outbound WebSocket connection, with session resume, attachments, model/mode switching, and tool-approval cards.
tools.description_zh: macOS 守护进程与生命周期 Hook 插件，通过企微智能机器人长连接（无需公网服务器）在手机企业微信遥控本机 Antigravity (agy) 终端会话与后台 agy acp 会话，支持会话切换与历史恢复、附件投递、模型/权限模式切换、工具审批卡片与产物回传。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Built exclusively around Google Antigravity's native agy CLI, lifecycle hook plugin specification, and agy acp background session protocol.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 专为 Google Antigravity 原生 agy CLI、生命周期 Hook 插件规范与 agy acp 后台会话协议打造。

tools.name: antigravity-acp
tools.description_en: Bun-powered Agent Client Protocol server for Google Antigravity's `agy` CLI featuring live streaming and session history replay.
tools.description_zh: 基于 Bun 构建的 Google Antigravity `agy` CLI ACP 服务端，支持实时流式输出与会话历史回放。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Dedicated ACP server bridge written specifically for driving `agy` CLI sessions from ACP editors.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 专为驱动 `agy` CLI 并提供流式回放的独立 ACP 服务端。
tools.install_hint: Run with Bun following repository instructions

tools.name: antigravity-skill-porter
tools.description_en: CLI tool specifically adapting, wrapping, and validating external skills into native Antigravity plugins with `plugin.json` and tool name mapping.
tools.description_zh: 专门用于将外部技能代码适配并打包为规范 Antigravity 原生插件（自动补全 `plugin.json` 与生命周期配置）的转换脚手架。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Targets Antigravity's native `plugin.json` manifest format and tool namespace mapping directly.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 严格面向 Antigravity 原生 `plugin.json` 规范与工具名映射进行打包迁移。

tools.name: flow2api
tools.description_en: OpenAI and Gemini compatible API gateway for Google Flow (Veo 3.1, Nano Banana, and Omni) featuring multi-account pooling, automatic cookie refresh, and proxy support.
tools.description_zh: 面向 Google Flow（Veo 3.1、Nano Banana 与 Omni）的 OpenAI 与 Gemini 兼容 API 网关，支持多账号池负载均衡、Cookie 自动刷新、代理与 Web 管理后台。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Companion Google AI Pro/Ultra media gateway exposing Google Flow image and video generation alongside Antigravity workflows over OpenAI/Gemini APIs.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: Google AI Pro/Ultra 同订阅生态配套媒体网关，将 Google Flow 生图与视频能力以 OpenAI/Gemini 标准接口接入 Antigravity 工作流。
tools.install_hint: Run via Docker Compose or Python 3.8+ per repository README

tools.name: liftgate
tools.description_en: Run Antigravity as a local OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages gateway via official `agy acp` over stdio with native GPUI desktop and TUI controls.
tools.description_zh: 专为 Antigravity 官方 `agy acp`（Agent Client Protocol）通道构建的原生 API 网关与 GPUI 桌面控制中心，免除任何账号池与封号风险。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Built natively on Google Antigravity's official `agy acp` stdio Agent Client Protocol.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 原生基于 Antigravity 官方 `agy acp` 标准输入输出协议构建本地兼容网关。
tools.install_hint: Build with Cargo or download binary from GitHub Releases

tools.name: refined-antigravity-acp
tools.description_en: Drop-in refined Google Antigravity ACP binary wrapper resolving protocol compatibility quirks for external ACP clients.
tools.description_zh: 开箱即用的 Google Antigravity ACP 协议增强封装二进制，修复第三方 ACP 客户端接入时的兼容性边界问题。
tools.exclusivity_reason_en: Wraps and normalizes Google Antigravity's native ACP protocol stream specifically.
tools.exclusivity_reason_zh: 专门封装并规范化 Google Antigravity 原生 ACP 协议流。
tools.install_hint: Install via npm/npx per repository README
